Friday, July 31, 2026

Friday, July 31 — Psalm 90:1–17
Joshua 8:1–29; Luke 12:35–48

I will now refine and test them. Jeremiah 9:7

Pray that you may not come into the time of trial. Luke 22:40

Great I Am, as we walk through life’s trials, hear our prayer. When all seems lost, hear our prayer. When hope springs eternal, hear our prayer. When we can do nothing else but praise your name, hear our prayer. Amen.
